graph.title: LED Bar Graph
notes: Parts are the same as step 1; none added or dropped.

The circuit image did not load, so connections follow the schematic and text: Uno pins 2-11 each go through a 220 ohm resistor to one bar-graph anode (A1-A10), all cathodes go to GND, and the potentiometer is across 5V and GND with its wiper on A0.

Layout is an assumption. The bar graph straddles the centre gap: anodes A1-A10 are in columns 1-10 (top half) and cathodes C1-C10 in the same columns (bottom half). Each resistor runs from its anode column to column i+11 on the top half. The pin wire plugs into that column.

The 10 cathodes each use a short wire to the bottom GND rail (bn). The rail is joined to Uno GND.1 by wire21. The potentiometer sits in columns 24-26 (GND, SIG, VCC). Its VCC goes to Uno 5V, its wiper to A0 and its GND to Uno GND.2.
Pin order (pin 2 to R1 and bar segment 1, up to pin 11 to R10 and segment 10) is arbitrary; the schematic only requires one pin per LED.
